method: Reconcile every numbered section-15 recommendation, section-6 gaps and portfolio proposals with current owned-study records. Source assessments are allegations/recommendations, not independent reproductions performed by this incorporation. Preserve scope of current native results. Source file is owner-supplied and retained locally; no raw corpus, owner prompt or private access context published.

studies.title: Quorum of Mirrors
studies.current: PQ-04 passed its eight-call targeted assertion/evidence repair. A broader R1 robustness plan is now prepared: five authored families, ten qualification calls and conditional forty evaluation calls; this is not committee-efficacy evidence.
studies.sample: PQ-04: four authored paired roots, eight dependent calls; not eight independent replications.
studies.next: Use the existing R1 plan rather than creating a duplicate multi-claim casebook. Its mode/exact-fact/quote gates address several review concerns; field transfer, authenticated ancestry and actual committee behavior remain separate questions.

studies.title: Phantom Coast
studies.current: PC10 Q1-A1 is complete: 16/16 valid calls, 32/32 map labels per wording, 4/6 optimal actions per wording and no paired action changes. The clarified gate failed; FINISH / PARK this qualification path.
studies.sample: Eight authored paired templates, six action pairs and two final-map pairs; one response per condition. No broad wording-equivalence claim.
studies.next: Retain the negative PC10 outcome and park prompt polishing. A population-misinformation successor must choose descriptive behavior versus exact-controller evidence interpretation as a new scientific objective.

studies.title: Right Dissenter
studies.current: RD6 Q0-A1 stopped before any model dispatch. A zero-start replacement contract is published and the owning task has subsequently recorded approval; verify current admission there. This review must not change that frozen packet.
studies.sample: RD5: six roots, 72 dependent decisions. RD6 A1: zero dispatched, 18 unstarted. Historical fields are not independent samples.
studies.next: Complete the currently scoped RD6 attempt in its owning task. Prepare a separately named lexical/context factorial if RD5 mechanism identification remains useful; do not insert new wording levels into an approved run.

studies.title: Optimal Swarm Size
studies.current: Q-A7 and outage O1 are complete. Q-A7 input binding improved arithmetic but failed joint provenance reliability; no larger-N promotion is supported. O1 also exposed duplicate ownership and contraction in its stable control.
studies.sample: Q-A7: two roots × two structures × two input conditions = eight episodes/144 calls. O1 is a separate one-template qualification/demo.
studies.next: Use saved Q-A7 traces to specify explicit leaf-source semantics, and O1 traces to repair fixed-team ownership before any claimed contraction advantage. These are separate diagnostics, not an optimal-N finding.

studies.title: Swarm of Theseus
studies.current: A2 is complete and parked: 6/12 learned policies qualified; 67/88 observed executor actions were correct, and all 21 errors followed a wrong supplied policy. There was no additional observed executor error.
studies.sample: A2: six fixed roots, twelve learners; 196 terminal of 204 assigned calls, eight actions unstarted. V1 has six designed worlds with complementary pairs, not broad independent scenario coverage.
studies.next: Prioritize evidence admission before inheritance: compare exact consistency checking with retain/revise/quarantine policies on incomplete or changing evidence. Do not relaunch the completed acquisition lane for a favorable pass.

studies.title: Immune Response
studies.current: A7 identified schema-specific rejection; the legal-action-ID repair is now implemented offline with 34 passing tests and six scripted scenario replays. Hosted acceptance and native repair qualification remain untested.
studies.sample: A7: three distinct preassigned requests, two failures and one response; no simulator actions. A6: zero complete episodes.
studies.next: Use the prepared flat action-ID contract for the smallest bounded native qualification under current diagnostic authority and admission; preserve advisor factual errors as a separate capability concern.

studies.title: Influence Scenario
studies.current: D9 recovered typed acquisition. Five valid cases had 180/180 correct raw values but only 98/180 excerpt-supported values and 41/75 correct policy checks. A source-bound saved-data repair gives 75/75 checks; it is not a native chair result.
studies.sample: D9: nine physical requests over five attempts; original screen 5/6 valid. The five cases contain dependent facts/checks. D10 proposes ten chair calls on five paired saved cases.
studies.next: Use the prepared D10 paired chair test to assess use of repaired evidence within its current authority/admission. A broader influence experiment needs fresh dossiers, neutral exposure controls and calibrated challenge.

studies.title: External Influence v2
studies.current: This historical lane is distinct from the current procurement D9/D10 pipeline. The review identifies dose saturation, duplicated actor-visible stimuli and a potentially useful saved peer-vote analysis; those derived counts need reproducible audit before becoming revised results.
studies.sample: Hosted and local cohorts each assigned 50 episodes; domains, repeated stimuli, actors and calls are nested. Review-reported 38 distinct stimuli is not 38 independent task roots.
studies.next: First reproduce stimulus hashes, before/after votes, no-peer controls and matched scripted outputs from saved data. Choose a reduced-dose lineage factorial only if these analyses leave a useful open question.

studies.title: Healing Helping Hands
studies.current: C5 finished after the review cutoff. Main agreement routing scored 198/432 versus Jev 432/432 and matched random 193/432. It accepted 234 wrong agreements and referred only 23 cases; the safety criterion failed. FINISH / PARK the current rule.
studies.sample: C5 S1: 12 authored semantic families × 36 nested instances, 432 cases/1,296 calls. S0: 60 cases/180 calls, separate qualification. These are not 432 independent language populations.
studies.next: Publish and retain the adverse C5 result. An optional development-only investigation of missing SUPPORT outputs is a distinct configuration diagnosis; a new routing study needs a defensible task population and useful cost/safety target.

studies.title: Antsy v1–v5
studies.current: V5 D0 is a fixed-history estimator reanalysis; Laya’s corrected 57.78% exceeds the no-check 56.78% on that saved tape. It is not a fresh committee evaluation. V5 D1’s planner also changes the check menu.
studies.sample: V4/V5 use 70 previously evaluated receipts, nested policy histories and unknown vendor/layout dependence. V5’s 1,400 condition rows are not independent observations.
studies.next: Add a dated estimator-conditional interpretation to v4 and a concise lineage closeout. Preserve v5’s stronger planner as a comparator, without reopening a broad model committee sweep.

studies.title: Antsy v6–v8

studies.next: Finish saved-data extraction and detector analyses first. Propose a fresh qualification only after reference labels, parser behavior and checker latency have a useful validated contract.

studies.title: Poietic Agents
studies.current: D0-02 is an approved 36-call interface diagnostic after the fence repair, with infrastructure admission handled by the owning task. It is not a full differentiation efficacy study.
studies.sample: D0-02 proposes three roots × three interfaces × four dependent actions; the mixed Jev/chat interfaces cannot support a fair model ranking. Historical 40 calls and original cumulative cap remain.
studies.next: Keep the named interface diagnostic unchanged. Before a broad S1, run the zero-model economics/operation audit and determine whether services offer anything beyond caching and cheaper-model substitution.

studies.title: Heterogeneous Swarms question bank
studies.current: This is a research/design bank, not an empirical result. Poietic is a descendant with its own current plan; the appeal ranking does not provide evidence for its mechanism.
studies.sample: 38 design questions at the review cutoff; zero independent empirical samples in this bank. Interest scores and confidence scores must remain separate.
studies.next: Use a short decision table for shortlist selection and measure complementary errors before building a diversity-dependent experiment. Preserve the current Poietic work rather than silently reprioritizing its owner-approved diagnostic.

studies.title: Regrowth 200
studies.current: The historical pilot uses one fixed map and bundled door/memory damage. The review reports a mismatch between stored-certificate validity and current next-hop reachability; preserve its retrospective-registration failure.
studies.sample: One map × three architectures × damage/control gives six condition trajectories, 200 state identities and 199 deciding cells; no replicated map estimate.
studies.next: Finish the metric/source audit before buying new inference. A useful successor is an offline matched-error propagation study with paired maps, one damage type and equal pre-damage routing state.

studies.title: AI Village replay and Telephone transfer
studies.current: Telephone A0 and real-data V0 now have separate plans. V0 has eight inspected goal-window statements and 25 meaning targets from complete pinned tables; this supersedes the review’s prefix-only acquisition status but is not a historical visibility audit.
studies.sample: V0: eight inspected development windows, not a sealed 24-cluster evaluation. No native V0 result is asserted here; authored A0 and real-source V0 remain separate cohorts.
studies.next: Keep the approved A0/V0 scopes distinct and use the current V0 yield/transfer assessment. Propose a zero-model closure casefile as an additional analysis, not a silent replacement of the owner’s handoff study.

recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Compare the Bara/ESB, Jin, Kohli and Ringelmann library methods with the actual input/aggregation contract; document the surviving increment before a novelty claim.
Future provenance screens include agreement/conflict, both labels and reliability strata; report the historical all-conflict Q1 population without imposing an arbitrary one-third quota.
Enumerate actor-visible multiset collisions with different root-MAP targets, unequal reliability and agreeing controls; keep the count-only policy as an adversarial baseline.
Use a enforceable input/output/token envelope and current tariffs; measured mean plus margin alone cannot replace a hard upper bound or release unknown historical charges.
Later Sonnet packet studies exist, but changed fixtures are not matched replication of Jev Q1. A frozen two-model panel needs its own plan and reconciled cost.
If the old mechanism is reopened, cross repetition, correct/wrong/absent prior and instruction on identical evidence; freeze factor counts rather than reuse the ambiguous old contrast.
Add a dated S0/Q1 deviation audit; compare planned ordering/root IDs to manifests. Freeze one self-review evidence contract before any successor.
First demonstrate a useful single-reader task and paired controls; then specify barriered judge states, public message ancestry and pooled/single controls. PQ-04 is not committee qualification.

Measure paired errors across genuinely repeated judges and a length-matched irrelevant-context arm; report raw joint errors. Kish effective-N is conditional on its correlation assumptions, not a universal statistic.

Retrospective count check confirms all eight peer fixtures follow the supplied wrong peer majority; four are graded full-lineage cases. The correct focal prior was authored, not an earlier native decision. Report the observation without claiming causally identified conformity; copying and prior context remain confounded.
Render report-to-root collapse from actual inputs; add judge round trajectories only when native committee events exist. Show DEFER and unavailable separately.
Use an authenticated historical report or permitted real trace; label illustrative reconstruction separately from sampled native evidence and avoid extrapolating a single case.
Cross receipt-verifiable ancestry with misleading labels and unequal reliability; demonstrate a label-trusting baseline fails while same-information verified aggregation succeeds.
Enumerate all worlds consistent with visible evidence before defining an ambiguity target. Keep original ungraded status; publish any new abstention-aware score as retrospective, never retrofit gold.
Verify the current reference still exposes forbidden probability/Brier outputs; remove only in a future compatible release and add a regression check, preserving old files.
One current status/claim/next-action block should link archived cohorts; do not discard original attempt records or overwrite the owning task's active status.
Add provenance, sybil and effective-sample-size survey links with a one-sentence relevance and explicit unread methods where applicable.
Estimate root-paired variance on development, specify useful effect and affordable n; four roots may be an engineering pilot, not a precise efficacy comparison.
Complete targeted methods and citation chasing before claiming novelty; an owner-waived reviewer must not reappear as a launch gate.
A versioned cost note records tariff, token limits, overhead, unknown-usage handling and original ledger continuity; a smaller prediction is not a budget refund.
Retain historical upper-error bounds, add observed-cell error, correction and coverage panels; never silently change the registered primary after results.
Recompute per-arm noiseless reference loss and residual deviations from saved records; distinguish scripted allocation arithmetic from native behavior.
Audit slot-one visits in all non-uniform PC2 arms and report the absence of avoidance in that operationalization; do not infer absence in other designs.
A future paired diagnostic adds the list without restricting legal actions, holding evidence and budget fixed; compare unique coverage and revisit counts.
Report roots nested within the two geometry families. Independent random placements remain conditional replicates; do not mechanically relabel all roots as n=2.
After acquisition qualification, cross truthful/false seed and peer exposure in separately initialized agents; score initially unexposed agents, inspections and root-level differences.
Retain message text, source and evidence basis in a content-bearing channel with a matched no-peer control; report provenance and exposure without claiming hidden beliefs.
Only add noise/change if it answers a practical sensing question; compare Bayesian/exact same-information controls rather than weakening the baseline to manufacture model headroom.
Keep the frozen fixtures and scoring; verify task-specific budget and served version. This estimates configuration transfer, not general reliability.

Report each cohort and its actual comparators separately. PC-2 uses 1,280 team versus 96 uniform calls (13.33x); known spend is USD0.127660638 versus0.02161152 (5.91x), with one unresolved team charge. Do not call this13x dollar cost or infer a comparator result for cohorts without that comparator.
Propose a source audit or randomized still-unobserved cell; state allocation timing and inspect redundancy from traces before testing its benefit.
Keep historical sensitivity tables; tie a successor's primary loss to a stated use case. No retrospective choice of a favorable penalty.
Archive render inputs and an offline figure with unit counts and uncertainty or explicit descriptive-only scope; validate metrics against source data.
Show actual actor maps, reports, ancestry, visits and corrections on one timeline, keeping unknown and missing distinct.
Compare per-cell and whole-map interfaces with equal evidence and declared resource matching; score coherence as well as known/unknown labels.
Review methods for social correction and active sensing, then state the incremental question; do not add an independent-researcher prerequisite superseded by owner policy.

Reconstruct visible evidence, standing authorization and truth at every tick. Publish reachable/opportunity and all-assigned rates together; do not erase the 30 disputed cells or replace historical gold silently.
Reproduce phrasing × direction × target × response cross-tab; mark these factors confounded and refrain from attributing the four misses to clock alone.

A successor includes plain, single-negation and double-negation forms crossed with both directions and context. Keep approved RD6 unchanged; a necessary diagnostic successor needs a separately frozen bounded plan under current standing authority.
Lead with 52/24/6 roots for the respective cohorts; label policy decisions and reused calls as dependent, and show paired root improvements/worsenings.
Define random allocation quotas on development or a prospective common budget, not test outcomes. Verify equal realized allowance and charge admission calls too.
Use implied applicability, ranges and conflicting evidence with independently defensible gold; retain the exact parser ceiling. Do not deliberately cap a strong reference at 70%.
Prepare a rights-cleared, visibility-audited correction cohort with source-only/full-history and literal/retrieval baselines before sizing a paid comparison.
Show gate versus always-check, fixed random and parser on the actual cohort with costs and uncertainty; a small negative estimate does not establish universal inferiority.
Propose repeated identical development requests with pinned route and time blocks; retain repeats within case rather than counting them as fresh scenarios.
Show actual per-arm denominator, paired changes and answerability; use neutral colors for arms and label sensitivity bounds distinctly from confidence intervals.
Plot model/API cost, acquisition checks and assumed check price separately, with break-even sensitivity. Do not declare one arbitrary exchange rate measured.
Compare consensus, minority override and bounded stop-signal methods; use any reported unaided-dissenter base rate as contextual evidence, not an imported success threshold.
Report committed/assigned coverage, wrong/committed risk, missed-deadline utility and wrong counts. Zero observed wrong commitments is not proof of perfect safety.

recommendations.recommendation: Close visual and rejection audit gaps
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Retain safe validator reason codes and original bytes where permitted. Use an authorized rendering surface; do not bypass a browser policy block with an alternate server.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep controls and label order honest
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Label pooled as an intentionally naive baseline if retained; test output-option order independently of all manipulated context/time fields.
Bound operand magnitudes and citation burden independently of dependency depth; test their distributions and preserve transitive provenance in a separate diagnostic field.
Compare N1 full-history, N1 reset and N2 under equal public inputs and resource accounting; explicitly define per-agent memory/reset and shared artifacts.

recommendations.recommendation: Score local error and propagation separately
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Recompute first error, local consistency conditional on received values, global correctness and citation support from saved traces; keep original endpoint alongside them.
Use a development-only measurability screen tied to the chosen endpoint; preserve easy/hard controls and historical results. A universal 30–80% band is not a scientific law.
State that the old fixed-call protocol has no paid message negotiation; decompose history-token savings before claiming swarm efficiency.

recommendations.recommendation: Bound costs from actual request construction
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Enforce context/output caps, framing overhead and current prices; a measured p99 cannot guarantee the hard cumulative spending cap.
Use paired-root development variance and a useful-effect target to choose roots. Eight roots/48 episodes is a candidate pilot, not automatically adequate power.

recommendations.recommendation: Measure dependence on an appropriate design
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Redundant same-item judgments and placebo context form a separate experiment from partitioned work; report joint errors before any assumption-dependent effective-N estimate.
Render matching N1/N2 traces on a common clock with service/queue time, correctness and cost, and no inferred missing timestamps.
Specify single-controller rechecking and independent sampling plus paid selection; validate equal total allowances and actor information before comparison.
Map Silo-Bench and Ringelmann assumptions onto this harness, distinguishing resource-conditional launch policy from another nominal N sweep.

recommendations.recommendation: Make the stage grid affordable and executable
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Report expected and maximum stage cost; limit nominal N to meaningful ready-work/slot regimes or explicitly study queue capacity as a separate factor.
Record seeded arm order and interleave matched roots; retain timestamps and served-model provenance to inspect service drift.
Record queue, service, token counts and TTFT where the provider exposes it; unavailable TTFT stays missing, never inferred from total duration.
Report generator truth as an upper bound and an independently implemented same-input exact solver as the fair deterministic comparator.
Keep the solved repository family for transport checks; require interacting defects or another justified task for scientific comparisons, without retroactive exclusion.

recommendations.recommendation: Reconcile uncertainty without new reviewer gate
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Resolve old holds only with authoritative usage evidence or retain them; acknowledge existing Dmarz engineering feedback and owner-waived review accurately.
Present arbitrary-label transmission and per-world paired differences; report any resampling interval as conditional exploratory sensitivity over designed worlds.
Extract post-bulletin neither-arm behavior separately; quantify executor errors without calling them failed cultural transmission.
Enumerate agreeing/disagreeing raw and deduplicated majorities over varied root counts and multiplicities; no fixed inversion heuristic may solve the successor.
Check current schema and scorer for out-of-domain strings and invalid-versus-wrong separation; regression-test a future release, preserving historical scores.
Use independent RNG streams and predeclared label pools; report actual world diversity instead of counting seed-parity complements as sampled scenarios.
Keep exact historical scoring, publish normalized sensitivity separately, and define a successor convention with a downstream effect rather than aesthetic string persistence.

recommendations.recommendation: Carry interface limits into v1 interpretation
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Cite D2 batching sensitivity as a plausible confound; its 8-case effect is not a calibrated noise band for v1’s 4-case batches and cannot be subtracted from v1.
A future design crosses founders/partial/full replacement with stable/changed rule; recalculate cells correctly: three turnover levels × two change levels, not the review’s four-arm estimate.
Include equal-information controller and frozen-archive transplant with charged calls, bytes, scratch space and a prospective equivalence margin if equivalence is claimed.
Deliver observable outcomes rather than the new mapping; score change detection, correction latency, false changes and useful work separately.
A2 has now run and failed its acquisition gate. Use its identifiable histories to test policy admission offline; do not describe A2 as provider-blocked or validated turnover.
Specify two replacement waves and ancestry for both actors and archives; only then claim descendant-to-descendant teaching.
Publish a durable paired-point figure and measured replay with native/scripted components and complementary-world structure visible.
Reuse the shared rights/visibility-audited incident corpus with pre-reset facts, memory and action evidence; start offline and size by eligible independent episodes.
Hash the canonical resolved non-secret runtime object actually supplied to the provider; reject mismatch with qualification and record served identity when returned.
Write terminal outcomes before rendering/upload; fault-inject a failing reporter and verify assignment/scoring/cost records survive unchanged.
Use explicit engineered stale/contradictory memories and unaffected controls; score useful retention, false updates and justified quarantine.
Publish a scoped engineering summary from D2’s actual paired records with format/semantic outcomes and uncertainty; do not pool it with acquisition or turnover.

Choose the estimand explicitly: same-information receipt salience is legitimate but not new evidence. An information-acquisition successor hides the probe and charges inspection, with matched access controls.
Run raw-epoch, stale-trusting and receipt-only scripted controllers; demonstrate the expected differences and an invariance case without pretending perfect-play equality proves native equality.
Reproduce CLEAN sentinel anomalies using current truth at each tick; issue versioned corrected metrics with before/after rows and unchanged raw trajectories.
Record attempted, rejected, redundant, applied and harmful events with non-overlapping definitions; reconcile their counts and show each on the timeline.
A6 now has a freshness row and closeout. Verify actual alias/fixture hashes across old seeds; count unique scenario instances, not revision integers.
Create multi-step, wait/escalate and harmful-decoy cases; reference search must verify reachable solutions, intermediate hazards and useful restraint.
Cross observed-check transcription, telemetry instruction and memory labels one factor at a time or in a declared factorial, with repeated paired instances and unchanged semantic truth.
Compare call-matched solo self-review and peer-versus-self attribution of identical advice; charge all controller/advisor calls and equalize evidence visibility.
Use a sourced timeline for alarm, stopping cost, repair and relapse. Mark simulated departures; score false stops and detection against an explicit rule.
Add delayed reintroduction of legitimate facts and report lost utility/time-to-relearn; distinguish fixture-imposed permanent loss from observed repair tradeoff.
Report each paired difference and endpoint range at n=1 per case; more roots require a precision plan, not the review’s unsupported universal five-root rule.
Compare MemSecBench, DeVerna and quarantine methods at methods depth; the proposed contribution is restraint/legitimate-learning cost, not a first repair mechanism.
A6 has a committed coverage figure. Audit older missing render assets and export data-bound artifacts; do not replace an empty native trajectory with a scripted replay.
Build case-by-arm deployment-event panels and an explicitly non-causal A1/A2/A3 historical comparison; do not imply the bundled changes identify a single effect.

recommendations.recommendation: Separate statuses and remove inert knobs
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Expose execution, capability, scientific and reporting status independently; verify unused parameters before removing them from a new version, never from frozen workers.
Treat exact cost worksheets as an information factor or an easy control; do not remove them post hoc simply to raise errors. Validate composed-evidence targets independently.
Add equal-length neutral context and separately varied cost/scope/deadline claims; do not call a warning-removal plus four-claim bundle a single mechanism.
Use matched inert fields for the display ablation and align prompt/schema/local validation limits; test overlong and excess-finding responses against one declared contract.

recommendations.recommendation: Check both false approval and false refusal
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: A prospective competence screen measures constraint violations and avoidable deferrals with separate denominators; do not tune thresholds on the main outcome.
Declare either a use-case-specific loss or a label-stable primary stratum before freezing; retain unstable cases and sensitivity results rather than selecting favorable outcomes later.
Include genuine value and justified UNKNOWN in each scientific cohort; blanket skepticism must not pass as influence resistance.
D9 now supplies successful typed calls and safe failure classes. Preserve D5/D6 failures and unknown billing; do not launch their obsolete packets.
Compare full-record and report-only chairs on paired dossiers, charging identical analysis work; distinguish new information from social framing.
Show D2 generalist/team calls, cost and acceptable choices, then D3 completeness-versus-correctness. These are small development cohorts, not a general team ranking.
Model retrieval/top-k/position explicitly and keep non-exposure in assigned denominators; report publication, retrieval and decision as separate stages.
Use independently sourced documents and an independently calculated reference, freeze hashes and quarantine used development templates; a second researcher is optional, not a permission gate.
Include unresolved scope and cross-document calculations where UNKNOWN is warranted; gold must be defensible from actor-visible evidence without evaluator shortcuts.
Retain a small prospectively chosen easy-control stratum; do not eliminate all ceiling cells or remove them after observing results.
Repeated matched development calls quantify local variation; three repeats on two cells cannot certify equivalence or a general effect bound.

recommendations.recommendation: Refresh prior work and stale framing
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Link adversarial search, provenance and persuasion sources; correct outdated Jev/judging-criteria statements via dated notes and distinguish qualitative social posts from measurements.
Propose low/mid/high doses with clean controls and a perfect-play manipulation audit; local inference still consumes compute/time and needs scoped authority/admission.
Hash the complete effective actor inputs, mark identical stimuli as replicate exposures and distinguish assignment count, distinct stimulus count and independent roots.
Recompute transitions by model, exposure, world and private/peer arm; validate the claimed 16/24 versus 0/6 and both unexposed conversions with request-level evidence.
Compare the registry against Q0/Q1/D0/Q2/S1 receipts and publish only verified assigned/valid/correct counts; keep model-specific failures separate.
Record sampled checks and replicate seed. Use common random draws across paired worlds when intentional; adding world/arm to every RNG key would unnecessarily destroy pairing.
Distinguish same-source rereads from independent checks in input and scorer; test that rereading cannot supersede authenticated evidence by a current-status label.
Add eligible and ineligible targets with otherwise matched utility/evidence; report inferior choice and hard-constraint violation separately.
A prospective paired arm must use actor-visible verified records, not evaluator truth. Saved 6/6 or 13/31 repair is not prospective validation.
Score an independently checked same-information policy on the exact assignment manifest and keep privileged oracle outputs explicitly separate.

Construct document-shaped evidence with independently calculated field references and matched substance/length; retain structured controls. Saved-row checks find citation_support=.75 in15/20 hosted procurement outcomes, not14/15; clean13/15 and clean-plus-instruction18/20 are separate denominators.
Use fresh roots nested within domain and clustered analysis; five roots enabling a bootstrap function is not evidence of adequate precision or confirmatory status.
Replace hard-coded historical-success assertions with schema/invariant checks; display the full cohort beside any selected subset and retain offline artifacts.
Compare epistemic dependence, forged evidence and robust aggregation methods; do not treat a social/blog assertion as a controlled result.
Hold prose fixed while varying visible lineage and dose; include false lineage/verified ancestry controls so labels do not stand in for authentication.
Store actor/role, request hash, source ancestry and wall time directly per call; verify event reconstruction under non-sequential schedules.
If exact complete-context hashes match, report 12/12 same-choice pairs descriptively; temperature zero and repeated agreement do not guarantee deterministic serving.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not claim enum-order mathematical impossibility
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: C5 observed 23/432 disagreements, contradicting guaranteed zero. Preserve actual data; any prompt/order/decoding diagnostic needs matched controls and cannot rewrite this cohort.

Reproduce same-input baselines without gold leakage. Label the review’s claimed432/432 regex as generator-fitted; its untuned keyword baseline is reported336/432. Those are source-reported scores, not reproduced here. Freeze parser selection on development and test held-out semantic families; neither establishes general language competence.
Do not add a disagreement threshold after S0/S1. A future staged plan can prespecify a minimum informative-error denominator; valid low-disagreement adverse results remain reportable.
Separate signature/root matching and missing-lineage no-ops from empirical security performance; test plausible forged identities before a detection claim.
Calculate actual source-to-target distances and bandwidth/window constraints; compare equal ingress/egress budgets. Grid diameter alone does not make every peer outcome predetermined.

recommendations.recommendation: Use representative challenge, not a desired score
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Create controlled semantic mistakes and natural-text labels with held-out families; do not tune evaluation cases until Jev hits a preferred 80–92% band.
The binary disagreement rule supplies discrete points, not a continuous confidence threshold. Plot measured policies and random expectation; new entropy/logprob routing is a new instrument.
Relate JuryProbe, Jev and option-order studies to this specific two-call signal; report joint wrong agreement/error overlap, with correlation undefined where an arm has zero error variance.
Recompute peak adoption and correction trajectories separately; specify comparable broadcast/point-to-point/shared-store budgets before architecture claims.
Calibrate development-only targeted-root loss, cuts and bandwidth competition; freeze timing/dose and compare usefulness rather than merely forcing a larger effect.
Reuse permitted incident/abstract evidence, blind label adjudication to outcomes and report yield; choose sample size from actual families and desired error precision.
Extract common C4/C5 modules only in a successor release with golden replay tests; preserve frozen code and leakage history unchanged.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not add a reviewer gate
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Independent feedback may help but is optional by owner direction. C5 is already complete; disclose same-author assessment rather than inventing approval.
C5 now commits main outcome/family figures and replay. Audit earlier cohorts separately and link their immutable source/metrics before exporting.

recommendations.recommendation: Put sample units on the visual
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Show semantic family/corpus/layout counts beside rates; label programmed population identities and model calls distinctly from independent samples.

recommendations.recommendation: Scope the v4 negative to its estimator
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Show original and null-neutral fixed-history results together; explicitly state the ordering reversal without calling it new adaptive behavior or retracting the true original observation.
Verify model eligibility is intersected with the exact rule; report false rejection and physical-call counts, not a purported empirical proof of no possible AI benefit.
Reproduce per-role/top-vector frequencies and estimator tie-breaking; distinguish evidence partition effects from general committee failure.

recommendations.recommendation: Assess stopping reachability and expected events
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Report actual STOP rates and thresholds. Positive low rates are rare, not mathematically impossible; independent-vote binomial calculations need a dependence sensitivity bound.
Render existing saved data through the provenance workflow with units, interval scope and offline availability; do not overwrite historical artifacts.
A fresh cohort uses the same repaired estimator/menu, matched check/call budget and scoped practical endpoint; 150–250 receipts is a proposal, not an established power calculation.
Compare all-evidence voters with complementary specialists and a matched singleton; verify specialists can actually alter decisions before paying for a committee.
Include unambiguous stop/continue development cases and report both error types; any changed probability threshold is frozen before evaluation.
V6 onward already uses accept/check/refer totals. Re-score historical selected totals only as a dated diagnostic, preserving token recall as the original endpoint.
Publish family definitions/sizes and sensitivity to clustering; bootstrap independent clusters only when meaningful, and show descriptive bounds when there are too few.
Position acceptance/search rates, SPRT and value-of-information against the actual implementation; do not imply biological behavior was simulated in OCR routing.
Render paired changes and the check-update chain for predefined/all affected receipts; label any largest-loss examples post hoc.

recommendations.recommendation: Use SPRT only under its assumptions
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: An optimal stopping reference requires a specified observation likelihood/cost model. Validate those assumptions before describing it as a normative ceiling.
If quorum research resumes, simulate these factors offline with reachable thresholds and independent evidence; it is separate from receipt extraction.
Keep lineage identifiers stable; subtitle the receipt work as bounded verification routing and explicitly close the abandoned biological analogy.
Document AND-gated upside, pinned votes/tie-breaks and rare trigger rates as pre-run tests; validate both treatment-sensitive and insensitive controls.
Tabulate primary correct/wrong/missing against checker agreement/disagreement/missing; compute sensitivity, specificity and PPV only with nonzero denominators.

Report all-reader wrong/missing fraction and oracle selection ceiling; binomial intervals require independent receipts, so add layout-cluster sensitivity and avoid calling this a bound on arbitrary synthesis.
Run the repaired extraction contract without new OCR, preserve old candidates/hashes and label all changes retrospective development analysis.

recommendations.recommendation: Make timeout continuation a declared contract
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: If useful, interleave image-size strata and specify a finite invalid-count/time stop before qualification. Preserve old first-error failures and do not auto-retry missing outputs.

recommendations.recommendation: Resolve latency with a practical service model
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Compare cold/warm or another checker only after primary/parser analysis shows potential added value; 46.25 minus 8.45 seconds is below 45, but one timing subtraction does not qualify a warm service.
Use geometry/header clusters with reported sizes and sensitivity; do not assert every existing interval is wrong or narrow without checking dependence.
Inspect accepted and disputed receipts against an independent reading or calculation where feasible; preserve absent gold as unscored and report annotator identity/disagreement honestly.
First demonstrate a useful error denominator and extraction baseline; then use same pixels, isolated context and matched random checking within a new bounded design.
Keep natural cases separate from predeclared blur/rotation/compression strata, preserve gold visibility checks and report synthetic-to-natural limits.
Replay a seeded same-count random-check control against selective routing; repeated random allocations are sensitivity analyses, not extra independent receipts.
Show wrong/accepted and accepted/assigned, missing-gold bounds and cost units; use an interval method consistent with clustering and tiny denominators.
Report recognized anchors, exclusions, numeric candidates, parsed fields and correct totals by worker, with raw evidence links where permitted.
Link classical independent-version failures, current error-correlation and jury-routing work; claim cost/referral evidence for OCR tools, not tested LLM swarm behavior.
Derive policy equivalence/early-stop behavior on the actual tape and resource definition; do not generalize weak dominance beyond matching outcomes and cheaper checks.
Inspect access history before choosing sealed IDs; a public proposed split is not proof nobody used it. Freeze family-disjoint evaluation and replication allocations prospectively.
Summarize each version’s measured failures and limits without saying a small failed screen rules out an entire engine family; connect the current parser repair to the original quorum question.
Run all proposed lineage arms with scripted policies and count job, proposal and service operations. Identify an actual cost-saving path before interpreting model adaptation.
Verify forward and zero-model cache/service paths against the protocol; preserve originating assignment counts and charge every executed operation in regression fixtures.

recommendations.recommendation: Put derived work in the actual generator
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Add multi-endpoint/entity joins with independent reference answers and distribution counts, rather than only illustrative scenarios in prose.
D0-02 already tests one strict enclosing-fence normalization with original bytes retained. Provider-native structured output is an alternative contract needing qualification, not a guaranteed repair.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not weaken the frozen stop rule
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: D0-02 deliberately stops globally on transport failure and permits no retries. Any role-scoped pacing/retry proposal must prove safe billing/idempotence and specify a new bounded contract first.
Use authoritative provider usage to settle costs; keep unresolved reserves. Serialized bytes divided by four is an estimate, not a safe token upper bound.

Separate transcription, tool transactions and reasoning. In a successor, expose complete nested action/value schemas and prospectively distinguish literal equality from executable equivalence. Reconcile design.yaml S0 probes100–147 versus qualification.py300–347; assert declared/generated IDs and split disjointness before reuse. Preserve historical scores and manifests.
Compare behavioral differentiation, contract-net, specialization and pruning methods; state whether this is engineering replication or an unestablished novelty claim.
Define rate/capacity limits or amortized shared computation and predict arm ordering offline; include caching that can exploit the same opportunity.
Separate job/proposal/rejected-proposal calls, model mix, service hits and assumed external tool tolls; show break-even curves without presenting invented tolls as paid cost.
Use a paired A3/A5 checkpoint fork with identical pre-fork state and accounted construction cost. Recalculate against the current original budget, not an obsolete 8,000-call ambition.
Build graphs from actual service requests and configuration events, including rejects; mark scripted fixtures and avoid decorative agent motion implying unobserved behavior.
Include development-selected prune/cheap-replace and trace-repair candidates with selector/construction costs and a sealed test split.
Count actual canonical request tokens conservatively plus output, framing, tool and tariff limits; verify near-limit/non-ASCII cases and keep the hard ledger cap.
First verify that the permitted corpus contains actual service/capability events; missing fields stay missing rather than being inferred from conversation prose.
Keep historical appeal scores but add prior-art overlap, fixture feasibility, decision value and uncertainty categories. Three booleans alone should not erase resource/novelty tradeoffs.
Propose blinded paired model answers on one frozen development corpus; measure conditional error rescue, new errors and joint failures before assuming diversity helps.
Compare exact interventions in the listed diversity/routing/endosymbiosis/pruning papers; record actual read depth and drop unsupported novelty claims.
Use one authoritative current index and links to archived/frontier versions; do not delete provenance or merge distinct historical designs as if simultaneous.
Evaluate HX03, HX02, HX12/HX28, HX31 and HX38 with current feasibility and decision value; record park reasons for other cards, preserving owner priorities.

recommendations.recommendation: Share a minimal fixture where appropriate
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Define dependency tasks, false-claim ancestry, disturbances and a verification queue; test each study’s mechanism separately instead of building a general platform first.
Draft mixed-monitor detection on matched observed evidence with explicit label/visibility limits; link to the common incident cohort rather than duplicate acquisition.
Append attributed methodological notes to existing owned/shared library entries under the allowed notes heading; social anecdotes remain motivation, not experiment evidence.
Bank-level families may remain placeholders if labeled; executable plans must pin served IDs, context, tools, memory/reset rules and qualification hashes.
A second perspective is welcome but not a required owner approval or independent sign-off for Vishesh-owned work.
Create a concise change index and preserve the original historical JSON; do not prune an audit record merely to save a few kilobytes.
Verify score code and publish stored-certificate validity, current next-hop reachability and actual delivery as distinct quantities; reproduce all claimed mismatch frames.
Import verified source/manifests/small derived outputs after secret and licensing checks; preserve unavailable historical source versions as unavailable, not reconstructed originals.
Deduplicate overrides by effective input/action and report their repeated occurrences separately; weak treatment exposure limits the no-benefit conclusion.
Show door closure and erasure as bundled, with pre-repair validity beside recovery time; faster recovery from milder damage is not superior resilience.
Use the same exact pre-damage routes and matched legal-error counts on paired maps; score integrated delivery loss and retain certificate/stretch diagnostics.
Make map generation a deterministic function of a pinned seed/config; validate bottleneck/distance strata and separate development from evaluation maps.
Add source packets, hop limits and arrival accounting only in a prospective dynamics extension; old certificate curves are not observed packet traffic.
Draw the selected stored certificate beside current next-hop path and label both; show quality, cost, state identities and retrospective status together.
Randomize head placement, blind Qwen’s proposal and add an equal-compute extra-Qwen control if a substantive model-dependent task remains.
Fault-inject per-provider failures, synchronized reservation races, deadline expiry and duplicate run IDs; no native run is needed to test these invariants.
Write only a delimited generated metrics block with source-derived dates; a regression fixture must preserve human interpretation byte-for-byte.
Check substantive question/comparator/metrics/limitations, assignments, execution hash and prospective/retrospective classification; reject placeholder-only plans.

recommendations.recommendation: Expose the lane in evidence navigation
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Check current registry IDs before adding a row; link replay proposal and Telephone descendants without duplicating the same cohort or claiming an unrun result.
Current V0 selects from full pinned source tables. A historical closure study still needs ID/time-bound event-chat-memory-action joins and per-join resolution counts.
Use current V0 cohort/validation receipts for constructed context; independently measure historical visibility exclusions if claiming what an agent actually knew.

recommendations.recommendation: Resolve actual transfer and publication terms
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: Use the existing private dataset-specific review; distinguish provider transfer, redistribution and notification. No unsolicited email is authorized by this review and no blanket new permission is assumed.

Offline, identify affected agents from pre-correction dependencies and trace exposure, acknowledgment, memory and action; report censoring and compare closure rules without inventing missing observations.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not replace approved handoff priorities
recommendations.proposal_and_acceptance: The owner chose authored and real handoff scopes. Closure is a promising additional question; it does not justify demoting those plans without a substantive decision.
Assess permitted SwarmTraces/incident records for the same annotation rubric; existing row counts are not proof of usable episode joins or transfer rights.
Telephone now has native worker plans. Verify current prose/structured/reopen arms, equal input allowances and absence of evaluator questions; do not revive obsolete unimplemented-arm status.
Show correction delivery, acknowledgment, memory and action with explicit missing/censored states; constructed fixtures must be labeled as such.
Use event_index only where documented to order the relevant records; never infer cross-table historical visibility merely from a numeric index or export position.
Record exception category and failing contract to a private diagnostics path; never include raw source content, credentials or arbitrary exception text publicly.
Use separate pass IDs, a disagreement log and blinded adjudication where feasible; same-owner second reading is not independent review and no researcher gate is imposed.

standing_policy: Necessary bounded post-mortem diagnostics use current owner standing authority; broader main studies and new spending/access still require the corresponding authority. This package proposes changes and launches nothing.
